text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's drive was so intense... I could 
feel myself falling further and further 
behind—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, I'm so frustrated……! I'm ashamed 
that I lost in spirit……!"
choice_data_list: Still, you gave it your all.
Let's use this failure as a springboard!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, the fact remains that I worked 
hard. So I should give myself some credit.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Alright... I won't forget the effort I put 
in today, and I'll keep giving it my all 
tomorrow too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm super frustrated about what 
happened... But that's exactly why I feel 
like I shouldn't forget it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Reflect properly on why you lost, what 
went wrong, analyze it, and—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I want to carry this momentum into the 
next race! So please lend me your help, 
Trainer!
